tooltip.solapplepie.disabled: This food does not contribute to food diversity.
command.solapplepie.solapplepie.no_permi: You do not have the permissions necessary to apply this command to other players!
key.solapplepie.category: Spice of Life: Apple Pie Edition
gui.solapplepie.food_book.benefits.activ: Your food diversity has reached this threshold, so this benefit is active.
gui.solapplepie.food_book.benefits.inact: This benefit will activate when your food diversity reaches this threshold.
gui.solapplepie.food_book.queue.food_que: A list of all foods eaten in the past that contribute to your food diversity.
command.solapplepie.solapplepie.origin.i: Origin cache reset for this player!
The Origins mod is not installed; there is no origin cache to reset.
command.solapplepie.solapplepie.origin.c: Origin cache reset for all players!
config.solapplepie.thresholds.tooltip: Ascending diversity thresholds. Entries correspond one-to-one to the benefit list.
config.solapplepie.benefits_unparsed.too: Format: [+/−]type,registry_name,value. Separate multiple benefits with semicolons; do not use spaces. Attributes are additive; effect amplifier 0 means level I. A leading minus applies a penalty below the threshold.
config.solapplepie.min_foods_to_activate: Number of meals required before any benefits can activate; 0 disables this requirement.
config.solapplepie.blacklist.tooltip: Foods excluded from diversity. Supports item registry IDs and * wildcards.
config.solapplepie.whitelist.tooltip: If nonempty, only these foods contribute to diversity and the blacklist is ignored. Supports * wildcards.
config.solapplepie.reset_on_death.toolti: Reset the food list and benefits when the player dies.
config.solapplepie.limit_progression_to_: Only track meals in survival mode.
config.solapplepie.queue_size.tooltip: Maximum distinct foods counted in highest-diversity mode; recent meals tracked in normal mode. Normal mode also uses startDecay and endDecay.
config.solapplepie.min_contribution.tool: Old foods retain this fraction of their base diversity contribution. Range: 0 to 1.
Multiplier for nutrition-based diversity of foods without a custom complexity value.
config.solapplepie.end_decay.tooltip: Meals since last eaten at which contribution reaches its minimum. Must be between startDecay and queueSize.
config.solapplepie.start_decay.tooltip: Contribution starts decreasing after this many meals since last eaten. Must be no greater than endDecay.
config.solapplepie.should_forbidden_coun: Excluded foods still occupy a slot in food history even though they contribute no diversity.
config.solapplepie.complexity_unparsed.t: Format: registry_name,value, for example minecraft:golden_apple,4. Overrides base diversity for that food. Item tags are not supported.
config.solapplepie.is_food_tooltip_enabl: Show the last time a food was eaten and its current diversity contribution in its tooltip.
config.solapplepie.should_show_inactive_: Also list benefits not yet activated in the food book.
config.solapplepie.keep_highest_diversit: Count the highest-complexity distinct foods ever eaten, up to Food History Size. Lower-scoring meals do not replace them. Time decay is ignored.
gui.solapplepie.food_book.queue.highest_: Only the highest-complexity distinct foods eaten contribute. Lower-scoring meals do not replace them.
